content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Vacancy Details (Post-wise and Category-wise)
content_sections.text: The institute has notified a total of 14 vacancies across various technical and isolated posts. The post-wise and category-wise breakdown is as follows: Note: Post Codes TC-03 and TC-04 include 02 anticipated vacancies arising on superannuation within the next one year.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a citizen of India.

rows.qualification_required: M.Sc. in Material Science / Physics or equivalent with a minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent CGPA).
MCA (Master of Computer Applications) or equivalent with a minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent CGPA).
M.Sc. in Chemistry / Applied Chemistry / Chemical Sciences or equivalent with a minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent CGPA).
B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering / Metallurgy / Metallurgical Engineering or equivalent with a minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent CGPA).
B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics / Instrumentation Engineering or equivalent with a minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent CGPA).

Ex-Servicemen JCO (Subedar or higher rank) OR equivalent rank in other Para-military forces with minimum of 10 years’ experience in security. (Relaxed to 5 years for Short Service Commissioned Officers / Assistant Commandants drawing pre-revised scale of Rs. 8,000-13,500, and 10 years for Inspectors from Para-Military Forces).
Ex-servicemen JCO in Army or equivalent other Para-Military Forces with 05 years of experience in the work of security.

SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects, with minimum 55% marks AND ITI certificate or national / state trade Certificate in Instrument Mechanic program/trade OR 2 years full time apprenticeship trainee experience in Instrument Mechanic Trade OR 3 years work experience in Instrument Mechanic in a Government/PSU/Autonomous body.

SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects, with a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate AND ITI certificate / National/State Trade Certificate in Fitter trade OR 2 years full-time apprenticeship experience in Fitter trade OR 3 years work experience in Fitter trade in Government/PSU/Autonomous body.

SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects, with a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate AND ITI certificate / National or State Trade Certificate (NTC/STC) in Machinist trade OR 2 years full-time apprenticeship experience in Machinist trade OR 3 years work experience in Machinist trade in Government/PSU/Autonomous body.

SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects, with a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate AND ITI certificate / National or State Trade Certificate (NTC/STC) in Laboratory Assistant (Chemical Plant) trade OR 2 years full-time apprenticeship experience in Lab Assistant (Chemical Plant) trade OR 3 years work experience in Lab Assistant (Chemical Plant) trade in Government/PSU/Autonomous body.

The applicant's age must not be below 18 years.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online through SBI Collect / online payment gateway. Fee is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process varies by post category and generally involves screening, trade tests, physical tests, personality assessment tests, and competitive written examinations. Technical Officer: Screening Committee recommendation followed by a qualifying Trade Test and a competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability Test, 50 Qs, 100 Marks), Paper II (General Awareness & English Language, 50 Qs, 150 Marks), and Paper III (Concerned Subject, 100 Qs, 300 Marks). Final merit is based on Paper II and III. Security Officer: Screening followed by Physical Standards, Physical Test, and a Written Examination consisting of Paper-I (Mental Ability & Personality Assessment, 100 Qs, 100 Marks) and Paper-II (Subjective: Comprehension, Report Writing, Security Regulations & Firefighting, General Awareness, 100 Marks). Security Assistant: Screening, qualifying Skill / Physical and Personality Assessment Test (100 Qs, 100 Marks), followed by a subjective Competitive Written Examination (100 Marks). Technician (1): Trade Test followed by a competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability Test, 50 Qs, 100 Marks), Paper II (General Awareness & English Language, 50 Qs, 150 Marks), and Paper III (Concerned Subject, 50 Qs, 150 Marks). Multi-Tasking Staff: Competitive Written Examination consisting of General Intelligence (25 Qs, 75 Marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 Qs, 75 Marks), General Awareness (50 Qs, 150 Marks), and English Language (50 Qs, 150 Marks). Total 150 questions, 300 marks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR AMPRI Recruitment
content_sections.text: Visit the CSIR-AMPRI official website at https://ampri.res.in and access the recruitment link for Advt. No. RECT-02/2026. Register using your name, email address, and mobile number. Pay the non-refundable application fee of ₹500/- online via SBI Collect / payment gateway (if applicable) and note the transaction number and e-receipt. Log in to the online portal and fill out the application form with correct details. Upload scanned copies of your recent passport-size colour photograph, signature, fee e-receipt, and all mandatory educational, category, and experience certificates (max size 1MB each). Verify all entered details and submit the application form. Download and retain a printout of the completed application form for future records. Do not send a hard copy by post.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Downloaded copy of e-receipt / payment receipt of application fee Recent passport-size scanned colour photograph and candidate signature Matriculation / 10th Standard marksheet or certificate as proof of date of birth Educational certificates and marksheets supporting essential and higher qualifications Caste / Community / PwBD certificate in prescribed Government of India format (if applicable) Experience certificate specifying dates of service and nature of work (if applicable) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employer for regular employees in CSIR, Government departments, autonomous bodies, or PSUs Discharge book/certificate or PPO for Ex-Servicemen Court judgment/decree and affidavit for widows, divorced, or judicially separated women claiming age relaxation

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill all eligibility criteria as of the last date of online application submission. Separate applications with separate fees must be submitted for each post code if applying for multiple posts. Candidates currently working in CSIR, Government organizations, autonomous bodies, statutory bodies, universities, or PSUs must upload a valid No Objection Certificate (NOC). No TA/DA will be paid for attending tests, except for eligible SC/ST candidates as per rules. All notifications regarding trade tests, written exams, and updates will be published solely on the official CSIR-AMPRI website. Selected candidates may be required to work in shifts (including night shifts), on holidays, and beyond normal office hours depending on job exigencies.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 06.11.2026 for Technical Officer and Technician (1) posts, and 16.11.2026 for Security Officer, Security Assistant, and Multi-Tasking Staff posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 14 vacancies have been announced across Technical Officer, Security Officer, Security Assistant, Technician (1), and Multi-Tasking Staff posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for CSIR AMPRI Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹500/- for General, OBC, and EWS candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, women, and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the fee upon uploading valid certificates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Technician (1) posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need an SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects (minimum 55% marks) along with an ITI certificate in the respective trade (Instrument Mechanic, Fitter, Machinist, or Laboratory Assistant Chemical Plant) or relevant apprenticeship/work experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any negative marking in the written examination?
faq.answer: Yes, negative marking applies to papers specified in the notification (generally one negative mark for every wrong answer in objective tests, while Paper I for Technical Officer and Technician (1) has no negative marking).

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply for multiple post codes?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for multiple post codes provided they satisfy eligibility criteria, but they must submit a separate application and pay the required fee for each post code.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the examinations be conducted?
faq.answer: Examinations and tests will ordinarily be held at CSIR-AMPRI, Bhopal, or other designated centers as specified by the institute.

faq.question: Q8. Do working professionals need to submit an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes, regular employees working in CSIR, Government departments, autonomous bodies, statutory bodies, universities, or PSUs must upload a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer.
